name: freeq-lite-ts
intent: Write a small chat server in TypeScript that speaks a subset of IRC, like a simplified freeq: nicknames, channels, channel and private messages, ping, and quit.
contract: It is a TypeScript program for Node 24, run with `node --experimental-strip-types` (so no enums, namespaces or parameter properties), standard library only (node: modules). It is started as `node --experimental-strip-types main.ts -addr <host:port>` and must listen for TCP connections on that address; the server's name in replies is `freeq-lite`.
